description: Give Yad a plain-language task to carry out in the user's real, logged-in browser (e.g. 'find the price of the first item on this page' or 'click the login button'). Waits for the task to finish and returns the result. Yad cannot check out, pay, or place orders without the user's direct confirmation.

goal.description: Plain-language description of what to do in the browser

maxSteps.description: Optional cap on how many browser actions Yad may take

url.description: Optional URL to navigate to before starting the task

name: yad_run_goal
title: Run a browser task
